full_page.content:
1950, April 25
The following is the faithful transcription of the hand-written original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY ROUTE 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
April 25, 1950
Feast of St. Mark
Blessed be God In all His designs.
Rev. James Molloy 76 Colorado. Ave. Detroit, Michigan
God Bless you Dear James - but now I must God bless Father James,
So at long last and hearty Congratulations. I started to write a couple times since receiving your personal letter and now I feel almost too late. Anyway I am remembering you and all the folks over on Colorado and hope to see you Sunday. I simply could not make it last Sunday.
Sincerely yours in the Sacred Hearts of Jesus and Mary Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original in Possession of : Sister Suzanne Molloy, I.H.M. 610 West Elm Avenue Monroe, MI. 48161
